title: 在 EnrollmentWizard 實裝 10% 批量折扣邏輯
content:
若學員選擇全部 6 個時段，總費用享 10% 折扣。

變更範圍：
1. 計算 totalSessions（從 course.schedules.length 取得）
2. 比較 selectedScheduleIds.length === totalSessions
3. 若成立則 applyDiscount = true，折扣 10%
4. 提交 payload 中加入折扣資訊（可選）

前端僅 EnrollmentWizard.tsx 的費用計算邏輯，無 DB 變更。

[待確認] 折扣是總金額折扣還是每堂折扣？折扣金額是否需要傳到後端 API（註記在 registrant 紀錄上）？

findings: 10% discount applied when selectedScheduleIds.length === all schedules
Subtotal and discount shown separately in order summary
Final total = subtotal × 0.9 when all selected

acceptance: Selecting all sessions shows discount line in order summary
Selecting fewer than all sessions shows no discount
verification: npm run typecheck && select all 6 schedules → see discount appearing in summary
